sources.description: Folders that contain the SVG files, relative to the config.

outDir.description: Where sprite files are written. Default "public/icons". Needs publicPath when set.

publicPath.description: URL path the sprites are served from, same-origin. Default "/icons".

moduleDir.description: Where the manifest and types are written. Default "svgworm".

flatten.description: Drop folder names from icon names. Default false.

color.description: Per-icon color overrides. The last matching rule wins.

match.description: Glob matched against the icon public name (NFC, "/" separators). The last matching rule wins.

color.description: "auto" classifies the icon, "mono" forces currentColor, "preserve" keeps the colors.
